entries.title: Psalms 85:1
segments: <<For the Chief Musician. A Psalm of the sons of Korah.>> Jehovah, thou hast been favorable unto thy land; Thou hast  brought back the captivity of Jacob.

entries.title: Psalms 85:2
segments: Thou hast forgiven the iniquity of thy people; Thou hast covered all their sin. Selah

entries.title: Psalms 85:3
segments: Thou hast taken away all thy wrath; Thou hast turned [thyself] from the fierceness of thine anger.

entries.title: Psalms 85:4
segments: Turn us, O God of our salvation, And cause thine indignation toward us to cease.

entries.title: Psalms 85:5
segments: Wilt thou be angry with us for ever? Wilt thou draw out thine anger to all generations?

entries.title: Psalms 85:6
segments: Wilt thou not quicken us again, That thy people may rejoice in thee?

entries.title: Psalms 85:7
segments: Show us thy lovingkindness, O Jehovah, And grant us thy salvation.

entries.title: Psalms 85:8
segments: I will hear what God Jehovah will speak; For he will speak peace unto his people, and to his saints: But let them not turn again to folly.

entries.title: Psalms 85:9
segments: Surely his salvation is nigh them that fear him, That glory may dwell in our land.

entries.title: Psalms 85:10
segments: Mercy and truth are met together; Righteousness and peace have kissed each other.

entries.title: Psalms 85:11
segments: Truth springeth out of the earth; And righteousness hath looked down from heaven.

entries.title: Psalms 85:12
segments: Yea, Jehovah will give that which is good; And our land shall yield its increase.

entries.title: Psalms 85:13
segments: Righteousness shall go before him, And shall  make his footsteps a way [to walk in].
